deployToken(((address,string,string,byte.details: `msg.value` must equal the sum of each extension's `msgValue`. Reverts if public      deploys are disabled and caller is not owner/admin, or if any configured      component is not on the allowlist.

params.deploymentConfig: Full deployment configuration (token, pool, locker, MEV module, extensions).

returns.tokenAddress: The address of the newly deployed token contract.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

recoverETH(address).details: `deployToken` already enforces `msg.value` matches the sum of extension      `msgValue`s, but ETH can still arrive via `selfdestruct` or pre-deploy      coinbase rewards. This sweeps the contract's ETH to a chosen recipient.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.enabled: True to grant, false to revoke.

setDefaultProtocolFeeBps(uint16).details: Bounded by `MAX_PROTOCOL_FEE_BPS` (3000 = 30%) to prevent the factory      from squeezing too much of the artist's fee share.

setDeployFee(uint256).details: Bounded by `MAX_DEPLOY_FEE` (1 ETH) to prevent a misconfiguration      from pricing all deployers out of the factory.

params.deprecated_: True to block public deploys, false to enable public deploys.

params.enabled: True to allow, false to disallow.
True to allow, false to disallow.
True to allow, false to disallow.
params.hook: The hook the locker is paired with.
params.locker: The locker contract address (must implement IArtCoinsLpLocker).

params.enabled: True to allow, false to disallow.

params.token: The token address to look up.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

DEFAULT_TOKEN_SUPPLY().notice: Default token total supply used when a deployer specifies 0 (1B tokens).

MAX_DEPLOY_FEE().notice: Hard cap on the configurable deploy fee (1 ETH).

MAX_EXTENSIONS().notice: Maximum number of extensions per deployment.

MAX_EXTENSION_BPS().notice: Maximum combined extension allocation in basis points (90%).

MAX_PROTOCOL_FEE_BPS().notice: Maximum allowed protocol-fee bps share (30% of LP rewards).

MIN_TOKEN_SUPPLY().notice: Minimum total supply a deployer may specify.

admins(address).notice: Mapping of addresses to admin status.

claimTeamFees(address).notice: Sweeps `token` fees held by the factory to the configured team fee recipient.

defaultProtocolFeeBps().notice: Default protocol-fee share (in bps) injected into every new pool's         locker reward array as a dedicated "protocol slot". Defaults to         2000 (20% of trading fee) — the canonical artcoins protocol share.         Updateable by owner within `[0, MAX_PROTOCOL_FEE_BPS]`. Setting         to 0 disables injection (legacy behavior, kept as an admin escape).

deployFee().notice: Flat ETH fee charged on every successful `deployToken`, forwarded         to `teamFeeRecipient` at deploy time. Defaults to 0.069 ETH and         is updateable by the factory owner within `[0, MAX_DEPLOY_FEE]`.         Set to 0 to disable.

deployToken(((address,string,string,byte.notice: Atomically deploys a token, initializes a pool, places liquidity, and triggers extensions.

deploymentInfoForToken(address).notice: Lookup of deployment info for each deployed token.

deprecated().notice: When true, public deployments are disabled; owner/admin deploys may proceed.

enabledExtensions(address).notice: Allowlist of extensions invocable at deploy time.

enabledHooks(address).notice: Allowlist of hooks usable for new deployments.

enabledLockers(address,address).notice: Allowlist of lockers paired with specific hooks.

enabledMevModules(address).notice: Allowlist of MEV modules bindable to a pool.

recoverETH(address).notice: Owner-only escape hatch for ETH stuck in the factory.

setAdmin(address,bool).notice: Grants or revokes admin access. Owner only.

setDefaultProtocolFeeBps(uint16).notice: Sets the default protocol-fee bps injected into the locker reward         array for future deployments. Affects future launches only —         per-coin reward arrays are immutable after deploy.

setDeployFee(uint256).notice: Sets the flat ETH deploy fee charged on every `deployToken`.         Set to 0 to disable. Emits `DeployFeeUpdated`.

setDeprecated(bool).notice: Enables or disables public deployments. Owner only.

setHook(address,bool).notice: Enables or disables a hook in the allowlist. Must implement IArtCoinsHook.

setLocker(address,address,bool).notice: Enables or disables a locker for a specific hook in the allowlist.

setTeamFeeRecipient(address).notice: Sets the recipient of fees claimed via `claimTeamFees`.
